answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows make each identity’s stake slashable, while signed, correlated equivocation across k identities yields pairwise evidence and penalties scaling as O(k²). Detection also applies an explicitly escalating multiplier, such as 2^k, to the swarm’s capital loss; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery of the full bond. The gale, pulse, and saffron test cases verify that splitting control among aliases does not dilute liability.
